title: Vector and Terminal
author: Orsen Okonkwo
blurb: Vesper Okonkwo, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
